definition: Establishes or strengthens a CERT, CSIRT, security operations centre, security monitoring or cyber incident handling. A general statement that incidents will be managed is insufficient.
Deploys security technology on systems or networks: firewalls, intrusion detection or prevention, endpoint protection, encryption, public key infrastructure, secure configuration or hardening.

Controls who can reach systems and data: authentication, multi-factor authentication, privileged access management and role-based access. Citizen digital ID systems qualify only for their own access security.
Assesses security: vulnerability assessments, penetration tests, security audits, risk assessments or certification against a security standard such as ISO 27001.
Prepares or adopts a cybersecurity strategy, law, regulation, framework or mandatory standard, or creates or strengthens a cybersecurity authority.
Trains staff, operators or users in cybersecurity, or runs security awareness programmes. General digital skills training is insufficient.
